baseline.source: canon: WFB Chaos Dwarfs (Forge World lists; Storm of Chaos era): rule by Sorcerer-Prophets of Hashut, slave-driven hell-forges, Overseer castes, Infernal Guard; TW:WH3 Chaos Dwarfs
baseline.why: A theocracy of the Priests of Hashut over a caste of Overseers and Daemonsmiths: state-run industry, slave economy, censorship and police-terror, forge-armed standing regiments (tier 2); trade policy is isolationism because the Chaos Dwarf preset lacks stock_exchange, which protectionism needs (#8459)
